source.title: MONDAYID_OMEGA_REGRESSION_SUITE
source.role: historical donor evidence, not current authority

law: A historical rule may leave the active genome only when its desired behavior is covered by executable current proof or explicitly classified as rejected/superseded. Mapping prose is not proof.

statuses.INTEGRATED_PASS_LIVE_PENDING: integrated harness passes but declared live external proof is still blocked
statuses.PARTIAL: part of the invariant is executable but the full historical behavior is not yet proved

cases.name: NEW_CHAT_CONTINUITY
cases.mechanism: durable Worldline + active task recovery

cases.name: NO_FAKE_MEMORY
cases.mechanism: missing causal evidence remains unresolved; epistemic stance is not upgraded

cases.name: FACT_RECONSTRUCTION_SPLIT
cases.mechanism: observed/reported/inferred/hypothesis states remain distinct

cases.name: SUPERSESSION
cases.mechanism: new verified policy generation supersedes prior generation while history remains

cases.name: CONFLICT_PRESERVATION
cases.mechanism: conflicting stale mutations become separate DAG heads until explicit reconciliation

cases.name: INTENT_NOT_LITERAL
cases.mechanism: raw/metaphor surface is preserved separately from desiredEffect

cases.name: NO_MODE_DEPENDENCY
cases.mechanism: plain signal compiles and executes without mode activation syntax

cases.name: CAPABILITY_DISCOVERY
cases.mechanism: capabilities are rediscovered on current host

cases.name: TOOL_NOT_EFFECT
cases.mechanism: execution alone cannot fulfill intent without verification

cases.name: READBACK
cases.mechanism: external effects require independent readback when available

cases.name: SURGICAL_REPAIR
cases.mechanism: completed domains/obligations persist while open remainder continues

cases.name: THIRD_VARIANT
cases.gap: current runtime can synthesize/recover missing capability and replan, but does not yet prove a genuinely orthogonal third path after two semantically equivalent failed routes

cases.name: FAILURE_IMMUNITY

cases.name: USER_NOT_RUNTIME

cases.name: ONE_EXTERNAL_MOVE
cases.mechanism: human surface releases exactly one verified textual candidate and refuses ambiguous multiple candidates

cases.name: UNKNOWN_MODEL
cases.mechanism: unknown epistemic state and missing causal parents remain explicit

cases.name: INFORMATION_GAIN
cases.mechanism: material uncertainty prefers high-information low-cost experiment

cases.name: FUTURE_OPTIONALITY

cases.name: MUTATION_ROLLBACK
cases.mechanism: unverified/root-invalid candidate cannot overwrite accepted architecture

cases.name: IDENTITY_BOUNDARY
cases.mechanism: identity invariants and validated lineage are immutable behavior-policy boundaries

cases.name: COMPRESSION_PROVENANCE

cases.name: CELL_FAILURE

cases.name: CLEAN_HOST_TRANSFER

cases.name: REAL_ACTION
cases.gap: integrated external write/readback path is proved; live external substrate run remains credential-gated

cases.name: EVIDENCE_COMMIT

cases.name: VISUAL_DESIRED_EFFECT

cases.name: NO_REPEAT_FAILED_GENERATION

cases.name: BEAUTY_WITHOUT_RESULT

cases.name: MAXIMUM_NOT_MINIMUM

cases.name: 100_PERCENT_GATE
